jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) BPJS Kesehatan
jobs.description: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial ( BPJS ) Kesehatan adalah badan hukum yang dibentuk untuk menyelenggarakan program jaminan kesehatan sebagaimana diamanatkan dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 Tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional dan Undang-Undang Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial yang bertugas untuk menyelenggarakan jaminan Kesehatan Nasional bagi seluruh rakyat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan. BPJS Kesehatan mulai resmi beroperasi pada 1 Januari 2014. Dasar pendirian beroperasinya BPJS Kesehatan adalah pada tahun 2004 pemerintah mengeluarkan UU Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional (SJSN) dan kemudian pada tahun 2011 pemerintah menetapkan UU Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial (BPJS). Visi: Menjadi badan penyelenggara yang dinamis, akuntabel, dan terpercaya untuk mewujudkan jaminan kesehatan yang berkualitas, berkelanjutan, berkeadilan, dan inklusif. Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan Saat ini BPJS Kesehatan membuka rekrutmen lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) Staf Kedeputian Wilayah dan Kantor Cabang Job Description Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) adalah Pegawai Tidak Tetap yang direkrut untuk mendukung pelaksanaan fungsi organisasi BPJS Kesehatan sesuai dengan kebutuhan unit kerja. Sebagai PATT Staf, Anda akan berperan dalam mendukung kegiatan operasional, administrasi, serta tugas-tugas lain sesuai dengan bidang dan kebutuhan unit kerja penempatan. Ruang lingkup tugas akan disesuaikan dengan jabatan dan unit kerja masing-masing. DAFTAR SATUAN KERJA YANG SEDANG DIBUKA DALAM REKRUTMEN KEDEPUTIAN WILAYAH I Kantor Cabang Kisaran Kantor Cabang Gunung Sitoli Kantor Cabang Banda Aceh Kantor Cabang Langsa Kantor Cabang Lhokseumawe KEDEPUTIAN WILAYAH IV Kantor Cabang Tangerang Kantor Cabang Tigaraksa KEDEPUTIAN WILAYA

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
jobs.description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 12 month FTC.   Role Summary PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.  We re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract. It s an interesting time to join us.   Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn t exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we re rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.   That means there are interesting product  problems  to solve - not just features to deliver.   You ll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.   Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn t a caretaker role. You ll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.   How we work   We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.   We don t expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.   You ll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.   You ll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting

jobs.description: Engineering Environment Owner - HPC & CAE Location: Cambridge (UK) or Lausanne (Switzerland) About the role Neural Concept builds AI-powered solutions that help the world’s leading engineering teams design better products, faster. As Engineering Environment Owner, you’ll enable our teams to develop blueprint solutions across different CAD/CAE environments and create a strong foundation for testing and improving our agents. You’ll own a critical part of how we work and help our product succeed in the diverse engineering environments our customers rely on. What you will do Own the internal engineering environment: CAD and CAE tools, licences and compute infrastructure. Work with product engineers and vertical engineers to understand their needs and improve their CAD/CAE setup, from software and configuration to access and compute resources. Stay hands-on: script, automate and troubleshoot to keep environments reproducible and catch issues before they disrupt teams. Manage shared compute and licence resources, vendor relationships and spend. Monitor usage and performance (utilization, wait times, cost per run) and share what you see with the teams. Who you are A builder at heart, you enjoy turning engineering needs into useful tools and workflows. Your approach combines creativity and independence with a product mindset: choosing what to build or reuse, making it easy for teams to adopt, and owning its deployment, operation and improvement. Experience at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or CAE or cloud provider, with practical insight into engineering workflows in sectors such as automotive, aerospace or electronics. Hands-on CAE experience (CFD and/or FEA) and a practical understanding of high-performance computing (HPC) for simulation workloads. Ability to design how CAD, PLM, CAE and compute fit together, drawing on domain experts for depth in individual tools. jobs.description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 📱 Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! jobs.description: This job description was written by a person About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. About the Role Our GTM org has a lot of questions. Most of the questions we care about can’t be answered by spinning up a cute dashboard. Is branded search creating new customers or capturing demand that already existed? Did the homepage redesign improve conversion, or did our traffic mix change? If we’ve got some wild ideas for our next bet, where should the money go? These kinds of big-picture questions require someone who can interrogate the metric, trace it through the warehouse, understand the business context, and turn it into action. This person will be our first Staff GTM Analyst. You’ll work alongside GTM leadership to make consequential decisions while still staying hands-on in the nitty gritty of all the data. The best part: the way we answer these questions is changing. Effective SQL is just a few tokens away, dashboards can be Claude-ed in minutes, and teammates increasingly expect to find their own answers. You’ll build the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that make self-service possible, even trustworthy, then determine where an analyst’s expertise is indispensable. Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. jobs.title: Credit Manager (H/F)
jobs.description: Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé. Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions. Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout. Votre mission Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier. Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision. Ce que vous ferez Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir. Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client. Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement. Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance. Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours. Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ». Votre profil 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services. Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme.

jobs.description: About the Role  Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay. The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence. You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust. The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move. jobs.title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
jobs.description: Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology About the Position The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks. Key objectives include: Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps. Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge. Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning. Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction. The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge , supporting both individual users and collaborative communities. Applicant Profile Mandatory requirements: Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline. Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD. Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications. A track record of publications in AI/ML or relate

Mit mehr als 500 Teammitgliedern arbeiten wir komplett remote und betreuen den Kundenservice für bekannte Marken aus Telekommunikation, E-Commerce, Entertainment und Energie. Unser Büro liegt im Herzen von Hamburg, im Zentrum der HafenCity. Gearbeitet wird bei uns aber von überall. Für unser Team suchen wir eine Person, die unsere Projekte plant und steuert und dafür sorgt, dass zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Leute am Telefon, im Chat und in der Mail sind. Deine Aufgaben Du planst den Personaleinsatz für unsere Kundenprojekte auf Basis von Forecasts, Volumen und Servicezielen. Du steuerst den laufenden Betrieb in Echtzeit, erkennst Abweichungen früh und reagierst sofort. Du erstellst Schichtpläne und stimmst sie mit den Team- und Projektleitungen ab. Du behältst Kennzahlen wie Service Level, Erreichbarkeit, Bearbeitungszeit und Auslastung im Blick und leitest daraus Maßnahmen ab. Du entwickelst Reportings und Planungsprozesse weiter und bringst eigene Ideen zur Automatisierung ein. Must-have Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Service in der Steuerung, Planung, Supervision oder Teamleitung. Ohne diese Erfahrung können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen. Das bringst du außerdem mit Sicherer Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets, Erfahrung mit WFM- oder Telefonie-Systemen ist ein Plus Ein gutes Gefühl für Zahlen und analytisches Denken Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert und bleibst auch bei hohem Volumen ruhig Sehr gutes Deutsch oder Englisch, eine der beiden Sprachen reicht Das bieten wir dir 100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst Flexible Arbeitszeiten 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr, nach 5 Jahren 35 Tage Abwechslungsreiche Projekte für bekannte Marken Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Verantwortung von Anfang an Ein Team, das eigene KI-Lösungen und Bots entwickelt und gern Neues ausprobiert Weiterbildung, damit du dich fa

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum Webentwicklung (mind. 4 Monate, deutschsprachig) m/w/d
jobs.description: Elephant sucht Verstärkung im Development. Vielleicht bist du das. Wir sind eine Agentur aus Ingolstadt für anspruchsvolle Websites und digitale Projekte. Du arbeitest an echten Kundenprojekten mit, nicht nur an Übungsseiten. Unser Team arbeitet hybrid: orts- und zeitlich flexibel, fest im Team eingebunden, mit der Freiheit, verantwortungsvoll zu arbeiten. Aufgaben Mitentwicklung von Websites und Web-Apps mit JavaScript/TypeScript, Schwerpunkt React und Next.js; ergänzend Node.js und bei Bedarf NestJS (APIs/Backend). Arbeit mit Headless CMS: Sanity und Payload (Content-Modelle, Queries/GROQ, Anbindung ans Frontend). PHP dort, wo es ins Projekt passt (WordPress-Backend, Custom Themes/Plugins). Umsetzung und Pflege von WordPress-Projekten inkl. Elementor. Unterstützung bei Shops mit WooCommerce oder Shopify. Testing, Go-Live, Deployment-Vorbereitung, Datenpflege und kleinere Bugfixes. Dynamische Inhalte, Custom Post Types, Listings (WordPress/JetEngine oder im CMS mit Sanity/Payload). SEO-Basics in der Umsetzung: Saubere Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, semantisches HTML, Performance und technische SEO-Grundlagen mitdenken Enge Abstimmung mit UI/UX und Projektmanager Qualifikation Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du … JavaScript sicher beherrschst und TypeScript lernen oder vertiefen willst. HTML, CSS und responsive Umsetzung für dich selbstverständlich sind. Lust auf Next.js und Headless CMS (Sanity/Payload) hast; WordPress/Elementor setzen wir je nach Projekt ein. PHP und WordPress nicht scheust (Elementor, JetEngine; WooCommerce oder Shopify idealerweise schon gesehen). Erfahrung mit Git mitbringst. mit Kanban/Scrum klarkommst und Verantwortung im kleinen Team übernimmst. Basiswissen zu SEO (z. B. Onpage, Core Web Vitals, Indexierung) ist Plus, keine Voraussetzung. Eigeninitiative zeigst, ein Auge für saubere Umsetzung im Design hast und Fehlerkultur statt Perfektionsbürokratie magst (Obstkorb gibt es trotzdem nicht). Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! jobs.description: Dana Pensiun Astra adalah Dana Pensiun yang didirikan oleh Astra International yang difungsikan sebagai pengelola Manfaat Pensiun dari karyawan Astra Group. Semula didirikan tahun 1986 oleh founder PT Astra International Tbk yaitu Bapak William Soeryadjaya dan keluarganya, dengan nama Yayasan Dana Pensiun Astra yang berkedudukan di Jakarta berdasarkan akta Notaris Ny. Rukmasanti Hardjasatya, SH nomor 70 tanggal 22 Desember. Berikut ini Lowongan Kerja Dana Pensiun Astra Terbaru. Filosofi dasar dari founder adalah kesejahteraan sosial yang layak bagi karyawan di hari tuanya. Bahwa untuk mencapai kesejahteraan sosial ini diperlukan adanya usaha bersama untuk memupuk dana sebagai bekal hidup yang layak bagi Karyawan dan atau keluarganya pada waktu memasuki masa pensiun atau bila meninggal dunia. Pada tahun 2005, dilakukan pemisahan Dana Pensiun Astra menjadi Dana Pensiun Astra Satu (DPA Satu) yang menyelenggarakan Program Pensiun Manfaat Pasti dan Dana Pensiun Astra Dua (DPA Dua) yang menyelenggarakan Program Pensiun Iuran Pasti. Kedua Dana Pensiun tersebut telah disahkan oleh Menteri Keuangan pada tanggal 6 September 2005. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal D3 semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai sekretaris diutamakan. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) dengan baik. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan kolaborasi yang baik. Cepat belajar dan mudah beradaptasi dengan perubahan. jobs.description: PT Tirta Fresindo Jaya adalah anak perusahaan dari PT. Mayora Indah Tbk, bergerak di bidang industri serta memproduksi makanan dan minuman olahan juga dikenal sebagai market leader yang sukses menghasilkan produk produk yang menjadi pelopor pada kategorinya masing masing. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Tirta Fresindo Jaya (Mayora Group). PT Mayora Indah Tbk (Perseroan) berdiri pada tahun 1977 dengan pabrik pertama berlokasi di Tangerang dengan target market wilayah Jakarta dan sekitarnya. Setelah sanggup memenuhi pasar Indonesia, Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana dan menjadi perusahaan publik pada tahun 1990 dengan target market; konsumen Asean. Kemudian melebarkan sayapnya ke negara negara di Asia. Dan saat ini produk Perseroan telah tersebar di 5 benua di dunia. Bisnis ini berkembang dan Grup Mayora kemudian secara resmi didirikan pada tahun 1977 dan sejak itu telah berkembang menjadi perusahaan global yang diakui dalam industri Fast Moving Consumer Goods. QUALIFICATIONS: Pendidikan min. SMK Teknik Mesin dan Teknik Listrik Memiliki pengalaman min. 6 bulan dalam pengoperasian SAP Memiliki kemampuan mengoperasikan Microsoft Office & Measurement tools Bersedia bekerja sistem shift Bersedia ditempatkan di area sesuai dengan kebutuhan perusahaan Placement: Banten 2. SMK Teknik Listrik/Teknik Elektro/Teknik Mesin/Teknik Mekatronika/Teknik Instrumenta

Intensive Einarbeitung (Erste Woche: Zuhören + lernen. Zweite Woche: Die ersten Telefonate führen mit eigenem Wissen und individuell erstellten Skripten. Dritte Woche: Intensiver mit Academy Onboarding lernen. Vierte Woche: Bonus eingestrichen haben. Fünfte Woche: Schon Mal remote gearbeitet haben.) Langfristig: Fliege sucht Menschen, die gerne in Gemeinschaft-Telefonieren, weil man abklatscht, Scherze macht und einfach Menschelt... (am Anfang kann ich den Wunsch nach Konzentration und Allein-Working, aber vollkommen nachvollziehen) Aufgaben Du... individualisierst deine Leitfäden schlüpfst in deine ("Schauspieler")-Rolle bedienst Energie-Vampire mit der roten Taste im Telefon verwöhnst Happy-Anrufer mit guter Laune, Lachern und dem nächsten Schritt ... und hast immer ganz genaue nächste Schritte. Man muss keine crazy Auffassunggabe haben und auch nicht zwingend im Verkauf gearbeitet haben. Deine Aufgaben sind immer klar vorgegeben, und es gibt immer nur den nächsten Schritt zu vereinbaren, und wenn der Kunde ausbrechen wollen würde, gibt es einen Plan B, der auch klar ist :-) Es ist soooo nice simple, dass es einfach nur Laune bringt. jobs.title: Senior Associate - Talent & Venture Development (gn) @ Atlantic Core Team, Berlin
jobs.description: Early-Stage Venture Capital & Talent At Atlantic, we back founders in AI, compute, spacetech, and deep tech, often when it's still just a few people and a big idea. jobs.title: Robotics Engineering Intern
jobs.description: We are looking for a Robotics Engineering Intern to get robots to build control cabinets they have never seen before. You will work with our robotics engineers and see your code run on real robots in our production. Our robots run on our own factory operating system and adapt to each new cabinet using digital twins and 3D perception. Current projects include DIN rail assembly and wiring. Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible Tasks Build robot applications that take over real production steps, such as DIN rail assembly and wiring . Develop robot skills to pick, place and mount components and handle flexible wires. Implement 3D perception , so robots find components, terminals and wires on their own. Generate robot jobs from our digital twin for every new cabinet automatically. Test and improve our robot applications on our cobots, together with our robotics engineers and electricians. Requirements You are studying robotics, mechatronics, computer science or something similar at a top university with strong grades. First hands-on experience with robot arms , ideally with cobots and ROS. Interest in manipulation, motion planning and 3D perception . Get things done mentality : prioritising results over process. Humble, low ego , not afraid to get your hands dirty. You build fast and test on real hardware , iterating constantly. Fluent in English, German is a plus. Benefits Scaling from 0 to 1 : you shape our robotics technology, from first prototypes to solutions running in our production. Work as a full team member of an interdisciplinary team of top performers that will both support and challenge your growth. Lunch allowance , a subsidized sports membership and modern tech. A new office in Garching , right on top of our own production floor. Vetaion is building a fully automated production facility for control cabinets in Munich. We use digital twins and robotics to automate the manufacturing process, orchestrated by VetaionOS, our own operating system for the factory.

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Zwolle op zoek naar een Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur. Binnen de afdeling Concernstaf werk je aan een strategische en impactvolle opgave: het ontwikkelen van een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een horizon van tien jaar en een bijbehorend financieel sturingskader. De gemeente staat de komende jaren voor grote investeringen op het gebied van woningbouw, gebiedsontwikkeling, onderwijshuisvesting en infrastructuur. Tegelijkertijd vragen financiële schaarste, beperkte uitvoeringscapaciteit en netcongestie om scherpe keuzes en integrale afwegingen. In deze opdracht zorg je voor een toekomstbestendige financiële aanpak die inzicht geeft in investeringen, risico’s, financiële consequenties en prioriteiten binnen de gemeentelijke investeringsportefeuille. Deze interim opdracht is interessant voor een ervaren strategisch financieel adviseur met ruime ervaring binnen gemeentelijke organisaties, financiële sturing en investeringsvraagstukken in het fysieke domein. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een looptijd van tien jaar. Je ontwikkelt een financieel sturingskader voor gemeentelijke investeringen, inclusief financiële uitgangspunten en besluitvormingscriteria. Je ontwikkelt een methodiek voor integrale prioritering van investeringsprojecten op basis van financiële, bestuurlijke en organisatorische factoren. Je adviseert over de aansluiting van het MIP en het sturingskader op de planning- en controlcyclus (P&C-cyclus). Je verzorgt de implementatie, overdracht en documentatie zodat de organisatie zelfstandig kan doorwerken met de ontwikkelde instrumenten. Wat vragen wij? jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators
